in_marathi.name: Ramratan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramratan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means God and Ratan means grace or jewel. This name signifies the blessings and grace of God, and the person is believed to be protected and blessed by the divine.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's grace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramratan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram means God and Ratan means grace or jewel. This name signifies the blessings and grace of God, and the person is believed to be protected and blessed by the divine.
